meta.name: Murder in the hills
meta.description:
The seemingly natural death of a legendary movie star in Darjeeling threatens to expose a dark past of the serene hill station.

Complete series. On your server: S1 8/8

videos.title: Birthday Party
videos.overview: It's the 66th birthday of former superstar Tony Roy who has retired to Darjeeling. His local friends gather for his birthday party, where Roy suddenly collapses.

videos.title: Secret Diary
videos.overview: Amitabha finds a diary at Sheela's place and it reveals a dark chapter of Tony Roy's life. When he visits filmmaker Bijoy Mukherjee to know more about Tony Roy, he makes a stunning discovery.

videos.title: Dangerous Bob
videos.overview: While Tony Roy's friends attend his funeral, Amitabha follows up the clues found in the secret diary. On this trail, he is suddenly confronted by a sinister Bob.

videos.title: Kidnap
videos.overview: Amitabha finds a telling photograph at Dr. Neema Pradhan's clinic and another vital clue at DSP Subhankar Banerjee's place.

videos.title: Mysterious Cellphone
videos.overview: Bob rescues Amitabha from serious trouble. Amitabha reveals to Tony Roy's wife and his friend that someone might have killed the deceased star. Another murder taints the peace of Darjeeling.

videos.title: Suspicious Sheela
videos.overview: DSP Banerjee gives Amitabha a dressing down regarding his illegal investigations into Tony Ray's death. Late at night, Amitabha finds a bloodied Sheela at his door.

videos.title: Showdown
videos.overview: As Sheela lies in the hospital, Amitabha confronts everyone else and finally decides to write a detailed report on Tony Roy's death. What kind of danger awaits Amitabha?

videos.title: Ultimate Truth
videos.overview: Amitabha lands in Tony Roy's villa and finds himself surrounded by all of Roy's supposed friends. The plot slowly unravels towards an unbelievable revelation.
